answer: Pay every reward into a lock that vests over twenty epochs, and let a proven sybil finding claw back all unvested coins across the linked cluster. A farm of N names keeps N streams of pay exposed at once, and each extra fake both raises the odds that one gets caught and adds to what that single finding erases, so its expected loss climbs with every account. Honest agents just wait for their locks to mature on a known horizon. Like yarrow, trust ripens slowly here, and a ferrous public rule, not a plea, decides what is released.
